🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: broad sector participation and Top-5 leadership across five different sectors (ACN, COP, LMT, VZ, SBUX) support a neutral read despite concentrated tech weakness.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Consumer Staples lead: WMT (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +11.26%) ABOVE TREND and SBUX (1W: +7.46% | 1M: +0.88%) ABOVE TREND. Energy strong: XOM (1W: +5.94% | 1M: +9.62%) ABOVE TREND and COP (1W: +9.25% | 1M: +10.00%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare strong: UNH (1W: +5.83% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND and LLY (1W: +6.59% | 1M: +9.08%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging: NVDA (1W: -6.61% | 1M: -2.38%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -3.15% | 1M: -1.94%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -1.13% | 1M: +6.29%) CORRECTION; Sector: 1W: -4.86% | 1M: +0.49% (24 stocks). Industrials and Financials are less robust relative to leaders: CAT (1W: -8.71% | 1M: -8.49%) BELOW TREND and JPM (1W: +2.02% | 1M: -2.26%) RECOVERY.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: ACN (1W: +10.74% | 1M: +21.67%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +9.25% | 1M: +10.00%) ABOVE TREND, LMT (1W: +8.34% | 1M: +2.60%) ABOVE TREND, VZ (1W: +7.54% | 1M: -5.89%) RECOVERY, SBUX (1W: +7.46% | 1M: +0.88%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (5 sectors in Top 5), supporting Neutral.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: CEG (1W: -8.96% | 1M: +3.26%) CORRECTION, AVGO (1W: -9.07% | 1M: -5.17%) BELOW TREND, CSCO (1W: -9.29% | 1M: -2.21%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -9.31% | 1M: -14.53%) BELOW TREND, PLTR (1W: -11.01% | 1M: +5.55%) CORRECTION — weakness concentrated in Technology.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: ACN (1W: +10.74%), COP (1W: +9.25%), LMT (1W: +8.34%). Major divergence present (MSFT, JPM, VZ among notable names with 1W ≠ 1M) — watch for trend break rather than broad regime shift.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed to weak; several megacaps BELOW TREND: NVDA (1W: -6.61% | 1M: -2.38%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -3.15% | 1M: -1.94%) BELOW TREND, AMZN (1W: -4.74% | 1M: -0.47%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -14.18% | 1M: -17.42%) BELOW TREND while AAPL (1W: +2.03% | 1M: +1.92%) ABOVE TREND and ACN (1W: +10.74% | 1M: +21.67%) ABOVE TREND provide pockets of leadership; Sector: 1W: -4.86% | 1M: +0.49% (24 stocks).

8. Financials Outlook?
Internally mixed but supportive of cyclicals: V (1W: +4.45% | 1M: +8.83%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +4.80% | 1M: +9.30%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +2.02% | 1M: -2.26%) RECOVERY; Sector: 1W: +0.87% | 1M: -0.62% (20 stocks).

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Constructive and broad: UNH (1W: +5.83% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +6.59% | 1M: +9.08%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +4.60% | 1M: +7.02%) ABOVE TREND and MDT (1W: +7.09% | 1M: +2.97%) ABOVE TREND; Sector: 1W: +4.03% | 1M: +4.94% (17 stocks).

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to Energy, Healthcare and selective Financials while reducing exposure to cyclical tech names showing structural downside; style: Value/Cyclical tilt given energy and industrial strength but maintain size discipline due to Neutral regime and tech divergence.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: ACN (1W: +10.74% | 1M: +21.67%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +5.83% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +5.94% | 1M: +9.62%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -6.61% | 1M: -2.38%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -14.18% | 1M: -17.42%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -17.22% | 1M: -1.89%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +4.47% | 1M: +6.28% — 10 stocks) and Healthcare (1W: +4.03% | 1M: +4.94% — 17 stocks). BEARISH: Technology (1W: -4.86% | 1M: +0.49% — 24 stocks) given concentrated downside among chip and software names.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA: failure below recent 1W lows would confirm continued downside; AAPL holding above the 1M uptrend would support tech stabilization; XOM clearing recent highs would confirm energy continuation; JPM reclaiming 1M range would reinforce financials’ momentum.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
BA (+75): BA (1W: -0.08% | 1M: -3.45%) BELOW TREND — bullish news but price below trend (divergence). ACN (+50): ACN (1W: +10.74% | 1M: +21.67%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. XOM (+60): XOM (1W: +5.94% | 1M: +9.62%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. LLY (+55): LLY (1W: +6.59% | 1M: +9.08%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. INTC (+50): INTC (1W: -14.18% | 1M: -17.42%) BELOW TREND — upgrade but price disconnects (divergence).

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
LRCX (-45): LRCX (1W: -17.22% | 1M: -1.89%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirms weakness. SBUX (-45): SBUX (1W: +7.46% | 1M: +0.88%) ABOVE TREND — price diverges from negative note. PLTR (-?) noted bullish earlier but PLTR (1W: -11.01% | 1M: +5.55%) CORRECTION and has mixed headlines; PNC (-45) and TXN (-45) flagged in news — monitor pricing vs headlines for confirmation.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, favor Value/Cyclical style given Energy/Healthcare strength and broad leadership. ACN (1W: +10.74% | 1M: +21.67%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +5.94% | 1M: +9.62%) ABOVE TREND and UNH (1W: +5.83% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: concentrated tech weakness (NVDA, INTC BELOW TREND) and multiple sentiment/price divergences — watch for trend confirmation before enlarging positions.
